title: fix(console): AI pane names no lone agent; the drawer drops the empty header row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Ew4Ge2RjXufCRJ9pCgKWSC)_

Fixes #37146

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：右侧 AI 助手只有一个智能体时，顶部不再出现只写着「提问」的那一行，对话区直接从标题栏下面开始；有两个及以上智能体时，切换器照旧。
- 为什么做：AI 搭建入口关闭后，目录里只剩「提问」一个，这一行没有东西可切，只是占地方（卡上你的原话）。
- 出错会怎样：只影响助手顶部这一行画不画；不改请求、不改数据，可直接整体撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, the pane's `headerSlot`:

- With one launchable agent (`showAgentLauncher` false) the row no longer draws a `span` with the agent's name. The switcher arms (Tabs for up to three agents, Select above) are unchanged.
- `headerHasContent` = a switcher, or the build package chip (`isBuildSurface`), or Share/Doctor still in the row (`!actionsInHost`), or the offline note (`agentsError`). When none holds, `ChatPane` passes no `headerSlot`, so `ChatbotEnhanced` draws no wrapper, no band and no border. That is the drawer case: its host lifts Share and the Build Doctor into the drawer's title bar (`actionsInHost`, objectstack#35445).
- The full-page assistant follows the same rule. It keeps its row because Share (and the Doctor where offered) sit there, now with no agent name beside them.
- The row gets `data-testid="ai-chat-header"` so the test can name it.

Changeset: `.changeset/37146-ai-pane-lone-agent-header.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Why

Since the in-app build entry closed, the catalog usually serves only the ask agent. The row had nothing to switch and read only 「提问」.

## Verification

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.loneAgentHeader-37146.test.tsx` renders the real `ChatPane` and the real `ChatbotEnhanced`. Only the chat transport, the models list and the metadata and adapter providers are stand-ins:

- drawer (actions lifted), one agent: no `ai-chat-agent-picker`, no agent-name span, no header row;
- full page, one agent: no picker, the row holds Share, and no "Ask" text;
- drawer and full page, two agents: the switcher renders;
- drawer, one agent on the build surface: the row stays for the package chip.

Screenshots, right-side drawer at 1280×720, zh-CN, one `ask` agent served. These are a scratch dev-server fixture (the real `ChatDockPanel` + `ChatDockConversation`, with the AI endpoints answered in the browser) and are not committed. The project thread carries the image files:

1. Before (main `6f3a8da2`): under the 「AI 助手」 title bar, a bordered row holding only 「提问」.
2. After: the empty state starts right under the title bar, with no row.

<details><summary>Readings (head b0c6e50f)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.loneAgentHeader-37146.test.tsx` → 5 passed.
- Ablation: `AiChatPage.tsx` back to main's `headerSlot` (testid kept) → the two one-agent cases go red (2 failed, 3 passed); the fixed file restored → 5 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/` → Test Files 221 passed, Tests 1805 passed.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` → 69/69 tasks successful.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (merge base 6f3a8da2, 3 paths) → 38 commands, all 38 exit 0 (incl. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`).

</details>
